text_block_list.text:
Normally, for Umamusume aiming for the 
Classic Triple Crown, the standard route 
is to choose middle to long distances. 
However, King Halo is different.

To walk her own first-rate path, she chose 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen to crown the 
sprint king. Even if this is a mistake, 
she will have no regrets.

Naturally, the Trainer was prepared for 
that as well. Recognizing each other's 
resolve, the two agreed to start anew from 
scratch should that happen.
